name: Japanese Rural Towns, 大字, 字 and Districts
description: Towns named with 大字 (ōaza), 字 (aza) and 小字 (koaza), where the numbers are a land lot (地番) rather than a block, and towns and villages in a district (郡), written with and without the district. Original case written for this corpuss; shapes follow Japan Post's guidance on writing an address (郵便番号・住所の書き方), described in our own words; nothing copied.
